now.title: Captain Marvel
now.text: Att-Lass and Bron-Char fight Skrulls with Starforce, then hunt Carol on Earth, where her full power overwhelms them.
cases: ST-077 The Kree Assault on Earth (Captain Marvel)

proposed.text: Att-Lass and Bron-Char fight Skrulls with Starforce, then hunt Carol to Mar-Vell's lab, where her full power overwhelms them.

changes.evidence: In Captain Marvel, Starforce never goes to Louisiana or Earth's surface. Att-Lass and Bron-Char join the takeover of Mar-Vell's cloaked laboratory in orbit, and that is where Carol breaks free of the Supreme Intelligence and beats them both. Also F5: 'Louisiana' (Maria's home, where only Talos's Skrulls show up) is not where the fight happens.

now.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
now.text: Peter unlocks his suit's AI and names her Karen. She helps him at the Washington Monument and on the Staten Island Ferry, until Tony takes the suit away.
cases: ST-054 The Staten Island Ferry Disaster (Spider-Man: Homecoming)
ST-055 The Coney Island Plane Crash (Spider-Man: Homecoming)
ST-054 The Staten Island Ferry Disaster (Spider-Man: Homecoming)

changes.evidence: The record ends when Tony takes the suit after the ferry. The Coney Island plane crash happens later, with Peter in his homemade suit and no Karen, so the Coney Island place and the ST-055 case (F6) don't match this record. The Washington Monument rescue it names is Karen's (she guides him up the monument), and the app lists it as a Washington, D.C. location.

now.title: Secret Invasion
now.text: In episode 5, Raava, posing as Rhodes, pushes President Ritson toward war.

changes.evidence: In Secret Invasion episode 5 ('Harvest') Raava pushes Ritson toward the New Skrullos strike at his bedside in King George VII Private Hospital in England, after the attack outside London. She is not in Washington, D.C. in this episode. The app has no place for the hospital itself (London is the nearest listed one), so the place is dropped instead of guessed.
